The component is a single chat row (user/assistant bubble + hover-revealed copy/regenerate/edit actions); every prop name, state name, derived boolean, i18n key + English fallback, and the edit draft/submit/cancel machine are preserved verbatim.

L2 react-i18next useTranslation -> local useNativeTranslationFallback t(key, fallback). L3 lucide-react RotateCw/Pencil/Check/X -> SemanticIcon glyphs refresh/pencil/confirm/close via getSemanticIconDefinition(...).glyph (REGENERATE_GLYPH/EDIT_GLYPH/CHECK_GLYPH/CLOSE_GLYPH + COPY_GLYPH/COPIED_GLYPH). L4 @/components/ui Button/CopyButton/Textarea -> inline ActionButton (ghost/primary Pressable) + multiline TextInput; CopyButton's navigator.clipboard is browser-only so copy routes through an optional onCopyText host bridge (rule 7). L5 @/components/data-display Avatar -> the converted native parity Avatar ('../../../../components/data-display/Avatar'). L6 @/lib/cn cn -> dropped (RN StyleSheet). L7 @/lib/dateFormat formatTime -> inline native-safe port. L8 @/api/types ChatMessage -> the web-parity api/types mirror ('../../../../api/types'). L9 ./MarkdownRenderer -> inline native-safe AssistantMarkdown (react-markdown/remark-gfm are DOM renderers, rule 4).

formatTime helper (native port of the web @/lib/dateFormat subset used at L181): '—' FALLBACK on null/empty, NaN-guarded new Date(), and 2-digit hour/minute via toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}) — matching the web no-locale default. (Intl.DateTimeFormat is available in the parity runtime; DrivesListPage uses the same toLocaleTimeString path.)
UIChatMessage interface L11-21 ported verbatim: extends ChatMessage with optional isStreaming + streamedText, JSDoc preserved, still `export`ed.

ChatMessageItemProps L23-47 ported verbatim with identical JSDoc: message:UIChatMessage, isLastAssistant, isLastUser, isFirstInGroup, isLastInGroup, actionsDisabled?, onRegenerate?(message), onEditAndResend?(message,newText). Added one native-only optional prop `onCopyText?(text)` documented as the host clipboard bridge that replaces the web CopyButton's navigator.clipboard.writeText; when absent the Copy button is the explicit disabled/unavailable state and the bubble text stays selectable for long-press copy.
Function signature + destructure L49-63 preserved (named export ChatMessageItem); onCopyText appended to the destructure. ChatMessageItem.displayName added (native convention).

State + refs L64-68: t = useNativeTranslationFallback(); isUser = message.role==='user'; editing/setEditing(false); draft/setDraft(message.content) — all verbatim. The web textareaRef useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement> -> useRef<TextInput>. Added native-only copied/setCopied + copyResetRef to drive the CopyButton's 2s icon flip (web CopyButton owned this state internally; here it is hoisted since CopyButton is inlined).

useEffect focus L70-76: on editing transition, textareaRef.current.focus() is preserved. The web setSelectionRange(len,len) caret-to-end is documented as a per-platform RN caret (a controlled `selection` would fight subsequent edits); the focus intent is kept. Added a second cleanup-only useEffect to clear the copy-reset timeout on unmount (native side-effect hygiene for --detectOpenHandles).

startEdit L78-81, cancelEdit L83-86, submitEdit L88-96 ported verbatim: startEdit resets draft + opens; cancelEdit closes + restores draft; submitEdit trims, no-ops back to cancel when empty or unchanged, else onEditAndResend?.(message, trimmed) + close. Identical control flow and names.

handleEditKeyDown L98-106 -> handleEditKeyPress(e:NativeSyntheticEvent<TextInputKeyPressEventData>): reads nativeEvent.key, Enter && !shiftKey -> submitEdit(), Escape -> cancelEdit(). shiftKey is read off the (web/macOS/Windows react-native) nativeEvent via a widened cast, mirroring the web `!e.shiftKey`. preventDefault is browser-only and unnecessary natively (documented). Save/Cancel buttons remain the reliable touch submit/cancel path.

handleCopy (native): replaces the web CopyButton's internal navigator.clipboard.writeText -> await onCopyText(message.content) then setCopied(true) + a 2s reset; the catch swallows like the web CopyButton's catch (which console.error'd). copyAvailable = onCopyText != null gates the disabled state.

Derived values L108-111 verbatim: visibleText = message.streamedText ?? message.content; showAvatar = isFirstInGroup; showTimestamp = isLastInGroup && !message.isStreaming; showActions = !message.isStreaming && !actionsDisabled && !editing. Added editSubmitDisabled = !draft.trim() || draft.trim()===message.content.trim() — the exact expression the web inlined on the primary edit Button's `disabled` (L159).
